title: rDPS Meter
description:
Like ACT from FFXIV, or Details from WoW.
In multiplayer, this tells you how much damage you're doing, plus how much damage you're contributing to other players, minus how much damage they're contributing to you.
In singleplayer, this tells you which cards/relics/potions your damage is coming from.

Works with Poison, Doom, and most powers. Tracks damage from potions, relics.

[b]Please leave feedback![/b] This is a new mod and I'm actively working on it.

Also on Nexus Mods: https://www.nexusmods.com/slaythespire2/mods/1385
changeNote: 0.1.13 - the meter now follows the game's language: Simplified Chinese (简体中文) is fully translated, and every language now gets the font it needs, so card, enemy and power names no longer draw as empty boxes. Other languages fall back to English; translations are welcome on GitHub. The fight picker now lists each fight by name alone, without numbering it.
